reason: Client-side-only JS/Razor view changes scoped to Flows widget drag-drop UX, gated behind widget-type checks with sensible fallbacks, but relies on undeclared globals (draggedWidget, originalContainer) and dataset attributes that could throw if a widget lacks a content-type/definition, risking a JS error in the admin editor rather than any data or backend regression.
